changes: One Resume gets you back to your game. Campaign and Journey wins count each level once.
Your journeys and playlists keep their place. Solo and Hot Seat progress stay separate. Ready waits for you.

Refined bitmap lettering and new countdown numerals. Even counting to three got some attention.
